home.lead: Your personalized journey from arrival to departure.
home.body: Know what to prepare, what to do next, and where to take action throughout your Korea University journey.
home.allCompletedBody: You’ve completed your KU lifecycle plan. Review any stage whenever you need it.

features.marketplace: Find affordable items from other students

onboarding.title: Your KU lifecycle plan
onboarding.body: Follow the right checklist from before arrival through departure. Progress is saved on this device.
onboarding.recommendationHint: Your recommended next task is highlighted when it is in the selected stage.

arc.message: Requirements and procedures may change. Check the latest information on HiKorea before applying.

housing-reserve.title: Reserve housing
housing-reserve.description: Confirm where you will stay and keep your housing confirmation easy to find.
housing-reserve.practicalNote: Review the latest information provided by your dormitory or housing contact.

sim-compare.title: Compare SIM options
sim-compare.description: Compare general prepaid and postpaid options before choosing a plan after arrival.
sim-compare.practicalNote: Check current eligibility and identification requirements before purchasing.

airport-route.title: Plan your airport route
airport-route.description: Choose a general route from the airport to your housing and save a backup option.
airport-route.practicalNote: Check current transport information close to your arrival date.

arrival-essentials.title: Prepare arrival essentials
arrival-essentials.description: Collect the documents, contact details, and first-day essentials you expect to use.
arrival-essentials.practicalNote: Keep digital copies separate from your original documents.

dorm.title: Dormitory check-in
dorm.description: Complete your dormitory arrival steps and review the current residence guidance.
dorm.practicalNote: Use the instructions sent by the dormitory as the source of truth.

residence.title: Residence confirmation
residence.description: Confirm your current housing details and keep any supporting residence information.
residence.practicalNote: Check official guidance before preparing documents for an administrative application.

arc.title: ARC registration
arc.description: Review the current official guidance for registering your stay in Korea.
arc.practicalNote: Use HiKorea as the source of truth because requirements can change.

bank.title: Open a bank account
bank.description: Check current account-opening requirements before visiting a bank.
bank.practicalNote: Requirements and language support can differ, so confirm them before visiting.

sim.title: Get a Korean SIM
sim.description: Choose a current mobile option that fits your identification status and usage.
sim.practicalNote: Confirm current plan terms and identification requirements before signing up.

account.title: Activate your KU account
account.description: Set up access to the KU Portal and the digital services available to you.
account.practicalNote: Follow the current instructions from KU Digital Information Services.

courses.title: Confirm your course schedule
courses.description: Review your registered courses, classrooms, and current notices in KU systems.
courses.practicalNote: Use current KU notices rather than relying on saved dates.

healthcare.title: Find foreign-language-friendly healthcare
healthcare.description: Explore demo listings that indicate whether language support may be available.
healthcare.practicalNote: Contact a provider directly to confirm current services and language support.

campus-dining.title: Explore campus dining
campus-dining.description: Use the Local Guide to explore demo food listings around campus.
campus-dining.practicalNote: Confirm current menus and ingredients directly before visiting.

household-essentials.title: Find household essentials
household-essentials.description: Browse demo marketplace listings for items useful in student housing.
household-essentials.practicalNote: Listings and transactions in this prototype are demo-only.

student-marketplace.title: Use the student marketplace
student-marketplace.description: Explore how a KU-student marketplace could connect incoming and departing students.
student-marketplace.practicalNote: The current prototype uses demo verification; a live service would require a university email.

sell-items.title: List household items for sale
sell-items.description: Create a demo listing so incoming students can discover items you no longer need.
sell-items.practicalNote: This prototype does not process payments or messages.

luggage.title: Arrange luggage storage or shipping
luggage.description: Compare general storage or shipping options and keep your own booking details together.
luggage.practicalNote: Confirm current terms, prices, and restrictions directly with the provider you choose.

departure-checklist.title: Complete departure checklist
departure-checklist.description: Review your housing, campus, belongings, and travel tasks before departure.
departure-checklist.practicalNote: Add your own confirmed dates instead of relying on a generic deadline.

dorm-checkout.title: Dormitory checkout
dorm-checkout.description: Follow the current dormitory checkout instructions and confirm your room handover steps.
dorm-checkout.practicalNote: Use the latest instructions from your dormitory; this demo does not set a deadline.

move-out.title: Off-campus move-out
move-out.description: Review your confirmed move-out arrangement and prepare the housing handover.
move-out.practicalNote: Confirm responsibilities and timing with your housing contact.

marketplace.title: One student’s farewell is another’s fresh start
marketplace.body: List and reserve items without signing in. Sample items and live listings are clearly labeled.
marketplace.contactBody: This is a presentation demo. In a live service, your message would be sent through a secure KU-only chat.
marketplace.message: Hi! Is this still available? I can pick it up near campus.

form.title: List an item for the next student
form.body: Add an image to help buyers understand the item's condition.
form.success: Your item was added. It is now visible to incoming students.

marketplace.authRequiredTitle: Sign in to list a real item
marketplace.authRequiredBody: Guest plans stay on this device. Verify your KU email to publish a listing to the student marketplace.
marketplace.soldUnavailable: This item is already marked as sold.
marketplace.imageHint: PNG, JPG, or WebP · up to 8 MB; compressed before saving

localGuide.title: Feel at home around Anam
localGuide.body: A practical guide to places near KU. Kakao search candidates and internally verified places are shown together.
localGuide.empty: No places in this category yet.

anamClinic.name: Anam International Clinic · Sample
anamClinic.description: Sample listing for a nearby clinic that may offer language support.
anamClinic.tip: Call first to confirm current services, hours, and language support.

campusAnchor.description: A campus reference point for Korea University locations and building information.

anamHospital.description: Information about services and visits at Korea University Anam Hospital.

kuPharmacy.name: KU Gate Pharmacy · Sample
kuPharmacy.description: Sample listing for a pharmacy near campus.
kuPharmacy.tip: Bring the medicine name or a clear photo when asking for help.

seoulKitchen.name: Seoul Halal Kitchen · Sample
seoulKitchen.description: Sample listing for a halal-friendly meal near campus.
seoulKitchen.tip: Confirm current ingredients and certification directly with the restaurant.

greenTable.name: Green Table · Sample
greenTable.tip: Ask about sauces and stock if you avoid animal ingredients.

studyCafe.name: Campus Study Cafe · Sample
studyCafe.description: Sample listing for a quiet study-friendly cafe.
studyCafe.tip: Check current seating rules before a long study session.

neighborhoodMart.name: Anam Neighborhood Mart · Sample
neighborhoodMart.description: Sample listing for everyday groceries and household basics.
neighborhoodMart.tip: Compare unit prices when buying household essentials.

verification.authBody: We will send a six-digit code to an email ending exactly in @korea.ac.kr.
verification.linkSent: We sent a sign-in link to your email.
verification.openLink: Open the sign-in link in that email to continue.
verification.securityNote: KU Settle never asks for your password. Ignore any code you did not request.
verification.title: Demo student verification
verification.body: This prototype checks only the KU email format and does not send an email. A live service would require verification through an actual Korea University email.

profile.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Your profile, lifecycle progress, and every marketplace listing will be removed.
profile.deleteListings: All active, sold, hidden, and deleted listings
profile.importBody: Nothing is uploaded until you confirm. Demo data is never imported.
profile.setupTitle: Let’s set up your KU lifecycle plan
profile.setupBody: Tell us the basics so the arrival and departure housing tasks match your situation. No account is created.
profile.name: Name
profile.languageNote: You can change the language after setup.

admin.title: Demo admin panel
admin.demoNotice: A device-only demo management screen, not a secure administrator tool.
admin.confirmDelete: Delete this item and its reservations and reports?

reset.title: Reset this demo?
reset.body: This clears the saved profile, lifecycle checklist, verification, marketplace listings, search, and filters on this device. Your language stays the same.

validation.pickupScheduleRequired: Choose a valid pickup date and time range.
validation.positivePrice: Enter a price greater than zero.
validation.nameRequired: Enter a name up to 80 characters.
validation.validPrice: Enter a valid positive KRW price.
